A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, for the first time, we provide a NLO prediction for Higgs boson associated production with a top-antitop pair at the LHC, including parton showering and hadronic decays of the top quark, and we provide a detailed comparison to the corresponding predictions obtained from POWHEG-BOX, POWHEG, and MC@NLO, which are based on the same NLO calculation.
